faqs.a: Yes — we have a good selection of vegan dishes. Chana Masala, Saag Aloo, Vegetable Samosa, Onion Bhaji, Pilau Rice, and Chips are all vegan.
Yes — the Grosvenor Centre multi-storey is a 3-minute walk. Market Square car park is also very close.
Takeaway orders can be placed by phone on 01604 123456. We’re working on online ordering — watch this space!
Yes — all our meat is 100% halal certified.

faqs.q: Is there a minimum order for takeaway?
faqs.a: No minimum order for collection. We don’t currently offer delivery — collection only.
